description: Creates an app (with create) and maps connected accounts to it: Meta and Apple Ads ad accounts (spend), AdServices, AppsFlyer and Adjust apps (attribution), RevenueCat projects (revenue). Name an account by source_id or provider:external_id as this account lists them (e.g. meta:act_123, revenuecat:proj1a2b, adservices:com.example.app). For an ad account shared by several apps, set campaign_name_prefix so only that app's campaigns count. remove unmaps; history stays. Also looks the app up on the App Store (name, icon, developer) from its App Store id, bundle id, or a mapped AdServices or AppsFlyer app.

bundle_id.description: iOS bundle id; used to find the App Store listing when the App Store id is not known.

create.description: Create the app if it does not exist.

name: app_map_sources
title: Map accounts to an app
